you_should_know.title: 25 states sue FEMA and DHS, accusing Trump administration of withholding funding
you_should_know.summary: 25 states (incl. CO) sue FEMA/DHS over withheld disaster funds tied to elections/immigration — political-institutional dispute landing on the state, you-should-know.
